source.title: An update on Minc’s survey of open problems involving permanents

evidence.quote: We summarise the progress which has been made since 1986 on the conjectures and open problems listed in H. Minc’s survey articles on the theory of permanents.

trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH record to the exact journal article titled 'An update on Minc’s survey of open problems involving permanents' via DOI 10.1016/j.laa.2005.02.030 and ScienceDirect PII S0024379505001266. The readable landing pages exposed only bibliographic metadata and the abstract, not the article body or problem statements.

Source adequacy gate failed. Crossref and OpenAlex identified the exact work, but OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false and any_repository_has_fulltext=false, while ScienceDirect exposed only the abstract in the retrievable HTML. No readable exact-work full text was recovered, so no open problems were accepted.
